categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Anbiping Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry, focusing on tumor screening and precise diagnosis. The company develops, manufactures, and sells tumor screening and diagnostic reagents, automated diagnostic instruments, and AI-assisted diagnostic software, mainly serving pathology departments. It also provides pathology co-construction services and digital pathology solutions, integrating products and services for comprehensive tumor diagnosis.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including liquid-based cytology (LBP), polymerase chain reaction (PCR), immunohistochemistry (IHC), and fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH). It has developed automated and digital pathology platforms, including full-process automated liquid-based cytology systems, fully automated immunohistochemical staining systems, and digital slide scanning systems. AI-assisted diagnostic software enhances diagnostic accuracy and efficiency. Production follows strict quality control procedures with a 'sales-driven production plus reasonable inventory' model.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include over 2,400 medical institutions across China, covering tertiary hospitals, county hospitals, and grassroots medical institutions. The company also serves pharmaceutical companies through companion diagnostics. Its products and services are widely used in pathology departments for tumor screening and diagnosis, with a focus on cervical cancer, breast cancer, lung cancer, lymphoma, leukemia, and soft tissue tumors. The company is expanding into overseas markets such as Japan, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with a nationwide sales network covering all 31 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. It has subsidiaries and operations in key regions including Guangzhou, Beijing, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, Chongqing, Wuhan, Xi'an, Hunan, and Suzhou. Internationally, it has begun market entry and product registration in Japan, the European Union, Vietnam, Ukraine, Ecuador, and other countries, focusing on Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anbiping operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of IVD reagents and diagnostic instruments. It also provides pathology diagnostic services and digital pathology solutions, integrating upstream technology development with downstream clinical application and service delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in tumor screening and precise diagnosis, emphasizing multi-technology and multi-target joint detection solutions. It invests heavily in AI-assisted diagnostics, digital pathology, and companion diagnostics, aiming to enhance automation, standardization, digitalization, and intelligence in pathology. Strategic initiatives include expanding pathology co-construction services, deepening collaboration with pharmaceutical companies for companion diagnostics, and accelerating international market registration and brand building.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of self-developed and externally sourced IVD reagents and diagnostic instruments. The company also earns income from pathology co-construction services, diagnostic testing services, and technical support. Sales channels combine direct sales and distributor networks, serving hospitals and medical institutions nationwide and overseas.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Anbiping is one of the leading domestic companies in tumor screening and precise diagnosis within the IVD industry, distinguished by its comprehensive technology platforms and extensive product portfolio. It competes with international brands and domestic peers by leveraging its integrated solutions of reagents, automated equipment, digital pathology, and AI. The company holds a strong market position in cervical cancer screening and is recognized for its innovation and quality certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 470.79 million, a slight decrease of 5.33% year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 21.29 million, down 46.85%. R&D investment accounted for 12.76% of revenue. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 1.36 billion and net assets of RMB 1.26 billion. Despite short-term profit decline due to pricing pressures and increased sales expenses, the company focuses on long-term sustainable growth through innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anbiping offers a unique integrated tumor screening and diagnostic solution combining multiple technologies (LBP, PCR, IHC, FISH) with automated and AI-enhanced platforms. Its products are recognized for high quality, comprehensive coverage of tumor types, and strong clinical validation. The company emphasizes automation, standardization, digitalization, and intelligence to improve diagnostic accuracy and efficiency, addressing the shortage of pathology professionals and enabling resource sharing across medical institutions. Its domestic innovation and cost advantages support competitive positioning and international expansion.
